verdict.rationale: dlt ships a documented official CLI that creates, inspects, and deploys pipelines (dlt-docs-10, dlt-probe-5), plus a dltHub CLI/`dlthub deploy` command for scheduling and monitoring (dlt-docs-11, dlt-docs-15, dlt-docs-68), making it well suited to AI-native/agentic workflows alongside the AI Harness and MCP tooling (dlt-docs-14, dlt-docs-69). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community validation specifically of the CLI (not just the library) is absent.
